name: fab-restaurant
description: FAB Seafood - Website nhà hàng hải sản (React + Express + PostgreSQL)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend run db:deploy && npm --prefix backend run generate && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
